audience_scope: K-3 multilingual classrooms — international schools, dual-language programs, bilingual European schools, and similar contexts where children ages 3-7 learn in or alongside languages other than the dominant local language
framework_alignment_references: CCSS — Common Core State Standards (US), K-3 ELA + Math
EYFS — Early Years Foundation Stage (UK), Early Learning Goals
IB PYP — International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme (3-7 ages)
EU Early Childhood Frameworks — generalized via European Reference Framework
doctrine_notes: Targets are theme-agnostic at the taxonomy layer; theme is selected at material-render time. Preserves the §1 SEO flywheel — theme axis stays crawlable independent of the curriculum axis.
K-3 unified age range; differentiation lives in per-exercise customization parameters at composition time.

Targets describe pedagogical learning OUTCOMES, not worksheet mechanics. The keying space is distinct from topics-taxonomy.json axis-keys (which key on mechanics/themes/levels). See docs/lesson-plans/existing-plan-substrate.md §7.

Multilingual K-3 register: targets that are inherently language-bound (vocabulary acquisition, phonics patterns) name the language-bound surface explicitly (e.g., 'identify-and-name-10-farm-animals' specifies the count and category but not the specific language; the package-author chooses the locale at authoring time).

Receptive-vs-productive distinction (post-Phase-1 curriculum-agent revision): kids in multilingual classrooms understand vocabulary months before they can produce it. Receptive targets (`point-to-named-X`) are paired with productive targets (`identify-and-name-X`) so package authors can choose which level the lesson aims at. A 4-year-old learning Spanish in an English-medium classroom is appropriately assessed receptively before productively.

Phonics-system scope flag (post-Phase-1 curriculum-agent revision): the phonics-decoding strand below is shaped around English-CVC patterns (CCSS-aligned). Romance phonics (Spanish syllabic, Italian transparent), Nordic (Finnish 1:1 grapheme-phoneme), and Germanic (German V-vs-VV length) work differently. Targets like `read-cvce-words` and `read-r-controlled-vowels` are English-specific. Phase 2+ should add language-family-specific phonics strands when packages target those locales; for now flag at composition time.

Curriculum-standard alignment is illustrative not prescriptive. A target may align loosely with multiple frameworks; package authoring tooling does NOT validate alignment — it's a discovery aid for teachers who want to map packages to their school's standards.

Pending Phase 1 surface-gate ratification (agent-recommended additions; operator chooses to apply or defer to Arc 2): (a) Speaking & Listening strand — 10 targets; (b) Writing-Composition strand — 8 targets; (c) Personal/Social/Emotional Development strand — 8 targets; (d) Multilingual-specific strand — 5 targets; (e) Reading-comprehension expansion — 6 targets; (f) Numeracy gaps — 5 targets; (g) Romance/Nordic/Germanic phonics parallels — 4 targets. See docs/lesson-plans/taxonomy-v1.md §Curriculum agent critique for full list with pedagogical rationale.

domains.name: Early Literacy
domains.description: Phonological awareness, letter recognition, phonics, vocabulary, spelling, reading, and writing for K-3 multilingual classrooms.

strands.name: Phonological awareness
strands.description: Hearing, identifying, and manipulating sounds in spoken words — independent of letter identity.

targets.name: Identify rhyming word pairs
targets.description: Given two spoken words, decide whether they rhyme.

targets.name: Produce rhyming words
targets.description: Given one word, supply a rhyming partner.

targets.name: Count syllables in 1-3 syllable words
targets.description: Clap or tap once per syllable for short words.

targets.name: Blend onset and rime into words
targets.description: Combine /c/ + /at/ to say 'cat'.

targets.name: Isolate initial phoneme in CVC words
targets.description: Identify the first sound in spoken CVC words.

targets.name: Isolate final phoneme in CVC words
targets.description: Identify the last sound in spoken CVC words.

targets.name: Isolate medial vowel sound in CVC words
targets.description: Identify the middle vowel sound in spoken CVC words.

targets.name: Blend individual phonemes into CVC words
targets.description: Combine /c/ /a/ /t/ into 'cat'.

targets.name: Segment CVC words into phonemes
targets.description: Break 'cat' into /c/ /a/ /t/.

strands.name: Letter recognition
strands.description: Identifying letters of the alphabet and their basic sound correspondences.

targets.name: Identify all uppercase letters of the alphabet
targets.description: Name the 26 uppercase letters (or locale equivalent).

targets.name: Identify all lowercase letters of the alphabet
targets.description: Name the 26 lowercase letters.

targets.name: Match uppercase to lowercase letters
targets.description: Pair A↔a, B↔b across the alphabet.

targets.name: Identify primary consonant letter-sounds
targets.description: Match consonant letters to their most common sound.

targets.name: Identify short vowel letter-sounds
targets.description: Match A/E/I/O/U to short vowel sounds.

targets.name: Identify a letter by an image clue starting with that letter
targets.description: Given an image (e.g., apple), identify the letter (A) it starts with.

strands.name: Phonics & decoding
strands.description: Applying letter-sound knowledge to read printed words.

targets.name: Read CVC words
targets.description: Decode 3-letter consonant-vowel-consonant words.

targets.name: Read CVCe (silent-e) words
targets.description: Decode words with long-vowel silent-e pattern.

targets.name: Read words with consonant blends
targets.description: Decode blends like st-, bl-, fr-.

targets.name: Read words with consonant digraphs
targets.description: Decode digraphs sh, ch, th, wh, ph.

targets.name: Read words with common vowel teams
targets.description: Decode ai/ay/ee/ea/oa/ow patterns.

targets.name: Read r-controlled vowel words
targets.description: Decode ar/er/ir/or/ur patterns.

targets.name: Read common prefixes and suffixes
targets.description: Decode un-, re-, -ed, -ing, -er.

targets.name: Read Spanish CV-syllable words (language-family-specific)
targets.description: Decode Spanish words by syllabic chunking: CV (ma-ma), CVC (sol). Spanish phonics is syllabic, NOT CVC-based like English.

targets.name: Read Finnish words distinguishing vowel length (language-family-specific)
targets.description: Decode Finnish 1:1 grapheme-phoneme orthography including double-vowel length distinction (tuli vs tuuli). Finnish has nearly transparent orthography.

targets.name: Read German compound words by recognizing word boundaries (language-family-specific)
targets.description: Decode multi-morpheme compound words (Apfelbaum = Apfel + Baum). German routinely concatenates nouns; reading requires segmentation skill English doesn't need.

targets.name: Read French recognizing silent final consonants (language-family-specific)
targets.description: Decode French words with silent final consonants (chat, pas, beaucoup) and liaison contexts. French orthography-pronunciation gap is wide; pattern recognition is the path.

strands.name: Vocabulary acquisition
strands.description: Learning the names, meanings, and uses of words in the target language. The MVP slice for Arc 1 lives here.

targets.name: Identify and name 10 farm animals
targets.description: Recognize images of and name in the target language: cow, sheep, pig, chicken, horse, duck, goat, dog, cat, rabbit (or locale-equivalent set).

targets.name: Identify and name 10 zoo animals
targets.description: Recognize and name: lion, elephant, giraffe, monkey, zebra, tiger, bear, snake, crocodile, kangaroo (or set).

targets.name: Identify and name 10 common pets
targets.description: Recognize and name household pets across cultures.

targets.name: Identify and name 10 common fruits
targets.description: Recognize and name fruits familiar to the locale.

targets.name: Identify and name 10 common vegetables
targets.description: Recognize and name vegetables familiar to the locale.

targets.name: Identify and name 10 common foods (meals/snacks)
targets.description: Recognize and name common meals and snacks.

targets.name: Identify and name 10 body parts
targets.description: Head, arm, leg, hand, foot, eye, ear, nose, mouth, hair (or set).

targets.name: Identify and name 10 articles of clothing
targets.description: Recognize and name clothing items appropriate to the locale's climate.

targets.name: Identify and name 10 common vehicles
targets.description: Car, bus, train, plane, boat, bike, truck, taxi, motorcycle, ambulance (or set).

targets.name: Identify and name 10 rooms and parts of a house
targets.description: Bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, living-room, door, window, etc.

targets.name: Identify and name 10 classroom objects
targets.description: Pencil, book, notebook, table, chair, board, eraser, ruler, scissors, glue (or set).

targets.name: Identify and name 8 weather words
targets.description: Sunny, rainy, cloudy, snowy, windy, hot, cold, warm.

targets.name: Identify and name 10 common action verbs
targets.description: Run, walk, jump, sit, stand, eat, drink, sleep, read, write (gerund or imperative form per locale convention).

targets.name: Identify and name 8 basic emotions
targets.description: Happy, sad, angry, scared, surprised, tired, excited, calm.

targets.name: Identify and name family member terms
targets.description: Mother, father, sister, brother, grandmother, grandfather, baby, etc. — sensitive to family structure variation.

targets.name: Identify and use 10 color words
targets.description: Red, blue, yellow, green, orange, purple, pink, black, white, brown.

targets.name: Use size-comparison vocabulary
targets.description: Big/small/bigger/smaller/biggest/smallest in target language.

targets.name: Use spatial position vocabulary
targets.description: In, on, under, next-to, between, behind, in-front-of, above.

targets.name: Point to a named farm animal (receptive)
targets.description: When the teacher names a farm animal in the target language, the kid points to the matching image. Receptive precursor to identify-and-name-10-farm-animals.

targets.name: Point to a named zoo animal (receptive)
targets.description: Receptive precursor to identify-and-name-10-zoo-animals.

targets.name: Point to a named body part (receptive)
targets.description: Receptive precursor; can be on the kid's own body or on a picture.

targets.name: Point to a named clothing item (receptive)
targets.description: Receptive precursor.

targets.name: Point to a named vehicle (receptive)
targets.description: Receptive precursor.

targets.name: Point to a named color (receptive)
targets.description: Receptive precursor to use-color-words.

strands.name: Spelling & encoding
strands.description: Encoding spoken words into print using letter-sound correspondences.

targets.name: Spell CVC words
targets.description: Encode spoken 3-letter words by writing the matching letters.

targets.name: Spell tier-1 high-frequency sight words (~25-50)
targets.description: Encode the K/Grade-1 high-frequency sight word list (e.g., the/and/a/I/to/in/is/it/of/you for English; equivalent in target locale).

targets.name: Spell tier-2 high-frequency sight words (~75-100)
targets.description: Encode the Grade 1-2 extended high-frequency word list.

targets.name: Spell words with consonant blends
targets.description: Encode bl-, br-, st-, sp- patterns.

targets.name: Spell words with consonant digraphs
targets.description: Encode sh-, ch-, th-, wh-.

strands.name: Reading comprehension (sentence-level, picture-supported)
strands.description: Understanding meaning at the sentence level, especially with picture support.

targets.name: Match a simple sentence to its matching picture
targets.description: Read a one-sentence description and select the matching image from 2-4 options.

targets.name: Answer who/what/where questions about a picture
targets.description: Identify subject, action, and location in a simple scene.

targets.name: Predict a missing word from picture cue and sentence context
targets.description: Given a sentence with a blank and a picture, supply the missing word.

targets.name: Sequence a 3-event story from pictures
targets.description: Order 3 picture cards into a logical story sequence.

targets.name: Identify the main character of a story
targets.description: Name who the story is about.

targets.name: Identify the setting of a story
targets.description: Name where and when the story happens.

targets.name: Identify the problem and solution in a simple story
targets.description: Recognize the central tension and how it resolves.

targets.name: Distinguish fiction from nonfiction
targets.description: Tell whether a book or text is a story (fiction) or factual (nonfiction).

targets.name: Read and follow a 2-sentence written instruction
targets.description: Decode and act on a short written instruction (e.g., 'Cut the picture. Glue it on the page.').

targets.name: Infer how a character feels from picture and text cues
targets.description: Use facial expressions + sentence context to infer emotion.

strands.name: Speaking & listening
strands.description: Oral-language skills — load-bearing for multilingual K-3 classrooms where receptive comprehension and oral production precede literacy. Added at Phase 1 surface gate per curriculum-agent recommendation.

targets.name: Follow a 1-step oral instruction in target language
targets.description: When teacher says one action, the kid does it (e.g., 'Stand up').

targets.name: Follow a 2-step oral instruction
targets.description: Sequence two actions in order from one spoken command.

targets.name: Follow a 3-step oral instruction
targets.description: Sequence three actions; working-memory load increases significantly.

targets.name: Respond to a greeting in the target language
targets.description: Reply appropriately to 'hello/goodbye/how are you' in the target language.

targets.name: Ask and answer yes/no questions
targets.description: Form and respond to closed-ended questions in target language.

targets.name: Ask and answer wh-questions (who/what/where/when)
targets.description: Form and respond to open-ended questions; harder than yes/no.

targets.name: Retell a 3-event story orally in target language
targets.description: Listen to a story, then recount the 3 main events.

targets.name: Participate in a simple conversation with a peer
targets.description: Sustain a multi-turn exchange on a familiar topic.

targets.name: Recite a rhyme or short poem from memory
targets.description: Memorize and perform a short rhyme — strong for prosody and language internalization.

targets.name: Describe a picture orally in 2-3 sentences
targets.description: Generate productive language describing what's in an image.

strands.name: Writing composition
strands.description: Composing written language: from labeling pictures to writing short stories. Closes the Grade 1-3 writing gap. Added at Phase 1 surface gate per curriculum-agent recommendation.

targets.name: Write own name
targets.description: Form the letters of one's own first name.

targets.name: Label a picture with a single word
targets.description: Write the noun that names what's in the image.

targets.name: Label a picture with a noun phrase (article + noun, optional adjective)
targets.description: Write 'a cat' or 'a big cat'; introduces phrase-level construction.

targets.name: Write a simple sentence with picture prompt
targets.description: Use the sentence frame 'I see a {item}' or similar; produce one sentence.

targets.name: Write 2 sentences on a topic
targets.description: Sustain across two sentence boundaries.

targets.name: Write a 3-sentence story (beginning / middle / end)
targets.description: Apply story-structure shape to own writing.

targets.name: Use a capital letter at the start of a sentence
targets.description: Apply sentence-boundary capitalization convention.

targets.name: Use a period at the end of a sentence
targets.description: Apply sentence-boundary punctuation convention.

strands.name: Multilingual language awareness
strands.description: Pedagogy specific to the platform's K-3 multilingual differentiator: cross-language recognition, translanguaging, and language-of-utterance awareness. Added at Phase 1 surface gate per curriculum-agent recommendation.

targets.name: Name an object in two languages
targets.description: Given a familiar object, supply its name in the target language AND the home language. Foundation of bilingual lexical awareness.

targets.name: Notice cognate word pairs across languages
targets.description: Recognize that 'animal/animal/animale' or 'family/Familie/famiglia' are cognate. Builds vocabulary transfer skill.

targets.name: Compare greeting routines across cultures
targets.description: Notice handshake/bow/kiss/wave conventions; relate to language-of-greeting.

targets.name: Identify the language of a spoken utterance
targets.description: Hear a sentence and identify whether it's English/German/Spanish/etc. Receptive language-awareness skill.

targets.name: Respond in the target language when prompted
targets.description: When a question is asked in the target language, the kid responds in the target language (not the home language). Productive code-control skill.

domains.name: Early Numeracy
domains.description: Counting, number sense, arithmetic, measurement, geometry, and data for K-3.

strands.name: Counting & cardinality
strands.description: One-to-one correspondence, count sequences, and the cardinal principle.

targets.name: Count objects from 1 to 5
targets.description: One-to-one correspondence with up to 5 objects.

targets.name: Count objects from 1 to 10
targets.description: One-to-one correspondence with up to 10 objects.

targets.name: Count objects from 1 to 20
targets.description: One-to-one correspondence with up to 20 objects.

targets.name: Count by rote from 1 to 100
targets.description: Recite the count sequence to 100.

targets.name: Count on from a given number
targets.description: Continue counting from any number within range without restarting from 1.

targets.name: Match numeral to quantity (1-10)
targets.description: Pair the written numeral with the matching count of objects.

targets.name: Subitize quantities 1-5
targets.description: Recognize small quantities at a glance without counting.

strands.name: Number sense & comparison
strands.description: Understanding magnitude, comparison, and ordering of numbers.

targets.name: Compare two quantities — more, fewer, equal
targets.description: Identify which group has more, fewer, or equal items.

targets.name: Compare numerals 1-10 by magnitude
targets.description: Decide which numeral represents a larger value.

targets.name: Use >, <, = symbols with single-digit numbers
targets.description: Apply comparison symbols to numerical pairs.

targets.name: Order numerals from smallest to largest (1-10)
targets.description: Arrange a set of numerals in ascending or descending order.

targets.name: Find the number before/after a given number
targets.description: Identify predecessor and successor for any number 1-100.

strands.name: Addition & subtraction
strands.description: Combining and separating quantities; mental math fluency.

targets.name: Add within 5 using objects or images
targets.description: Solve addition problems with sums up to 5.

targets.name: Add within 10 using objects or images
targets.description: Solve addition problems with sums up to 10.

targets.name: Add within 20
targets.description: Solve addition problems with sums up to 20.

targets.name: Add 2-digit numbers without regrouping
targets.description: Solve 23 + 14 = ? — no carrying required.

targets.name: Subtract 2-digit numbers without regrouping
targets.description: Solve 47 - 23 = ? — no borrowing required.

targets.name: Subtract within 5 using objects or images
targets.description: Solve subtraction problems within 5.

targets.name: Subtract within 10 using objects or images
targets.description: Solve subtraction problems within 10.

targets.name: Subtract within 20
targets.description: Solve subtraction problems within 20.

targets.name: Find missing addend within 10
targets.description: Solve 3 + ? = 7-style problems.

targets.name: Use 'make-10' strategy for addition
targets.description: Decompose to make 10, then add the rest (e.g., 8+5 = 8+2+3).

targets.name: Add three numbers with sum within 20
targets.description: Solve a+b+c = ? problems.

targets.name: Add 2-digit numbers
targets.description: Solve 2-digit + 2-digit problems with regrouping.

targets.name: Subtract 2-digit numbers
targets.description: Solve 2-digit - 2-digit problems with regrouping.

strands.name: Place value
strands.description: Understanding the structure of multi-digit numbers.

targets.name: Decompose teen numbers as 10 + n
targets.description: Show 14 = 10 + 4, etc.

targets.name: Identify tens and ones in 2-digit numbers
targets.description: For 47, identify 4 tens and 7 ones.

targets.name: Compare 2-digit numbers using place value
targets.description: Determine which 2-digit number is larger.

strands.name: Measurement
strands.description: Comparing length, weight, capacity, and time.

targets.name: Compare two objects by length
targets.description: Decide which of two objects is longer or shorter.

targets.name: Compare two objects by weight
targets.description: Decide which is heavier or lighter.

targets.name: Compare two containers by capacity
targets.description: Decide which holds more or less.

targets.name: Order 3 objects by length
targets.description: Arrange shortest-to-longest.

targets.name: Tell time to the hour on an analog clock
Tell time to the half-hour
targets.description: Read times like 3:30, 4:30.

targets.name: Tell time to the quarter-hour
targets.description: Read times like 3:15, 3:45.

strands.name: Geometry & shapes
strands.description: Identifying and reasoning about 2D and 3D shapes.

targets.name: Identify basic 2D shapes
targets.description: Circle, square, triangle, rectangle.

targets.name: Identify extended 2D shapes
targets.description: Pentagon, hexagon, oval, star, heart.

targets.name: Identify 3D shapes
targets.description: Cube, sphere, cone, cylinder.

targets.name: Describe shape attributes (sides, corners)
targets.description: Count and describe sides + corners of 2D shapes.

targets.name: Compose shapes from smaller shapes
targets.description: Build a rectangle from two triangles, etc.

targets.name: Identify a line of symmetry in simple shapes (informal)
targets.description: Recognize bilateral symmetry informally — Grade 2 level (formal symmetry standard is CCSS.4.G.A.3, outside K-3 scope).

targets.name: Partition a shape into halves and quarters
targets.description: Divide a circle or rectangle into 2 or 4 equal parts.

targets.name: Identify fractions: half, third, quarter

strands.name: Data & graphs
strands.description: Sorting, classifying, counting, and graphing data.

targets.name: Sort objects by a single attribute
targets.description: Sort by color, shape, or size.

targets.name: Count objects in categories and represent on a bar graph
targets.description: Count items in 2-4 categories and fill a bar graph.

targets.name: Interpret a simple bar graph
targets.description: Read counts from a bar graph and answer comparison questions.

targets.name: Interpret a simple pictograph
targets.description: Read counts from a pictograph.

domains.name: World Knowledge

targets.name: Classify animals by habitat

targets.name: Classify animals as herbivore / carnivore / omnivore
targets.description: Sort by diet pattern.

targets.name: Identify the main parts of a plant
targets.description: Roots, stem, leaves, flower, seed.

targets.name: Describe the basic plant life cycle

targets.name: Describe the butterfly life cycle

targets.name: Identify living vs non-living things
